name: online-store
description: 🛒 Full-stack Hebrew RTL store for PC components: product browsing and filters, a local-first cart, accounts and server-priced demo orders. Built solo as part of my Software Engineering studies using React, TypeScript, Express 5 and MongoDB, with 2,450 automated tests and CI-gated deploys.

paragraphs: A Hebrew RTL store for PC components, built like a production system.
A React frontend, an Express API, a real database, and a pipeline that only ships what has passed.
🚀 Live demo · 🌐 Second site (Netlify) · 🔌 API health · 📚 Docs
features: Hero slider, brands, categories, listings and detail pages Done by the API, with shareable and reloadable URLs Brand and specification filters with result counts Totals and savings, kept in the account and followed…
Mobile navigation and layouts Keyboard navigation, live regions, automated axe-core checks Hebrew-first, with logical CSS properties
Scope & limitations (what is intentionally not included)
The catalog, the accounts, the cart and the orders have a real backend. The checkout is intentionally a demo, and the favorites are intentionally a browser-side feature.
The accounts of the first, browser-only version of the site were never stored on a server and are not carried over.

whatItDoes.text: A Hebrew RTL store for PC components, built like a production system.
